blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Reenacting the 2026 budget for fiscal year 2027 is not an option, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said as he expressed confidence that the proposed national budget for next year would be ratified before December 17. “Hindi option sa amin na ma-re-enact yung budget dahil masama yung ating ekonomiya. At kailangan natin ng fresh at bagong budget para bumilis yung takbo ng ating ekonomiya,” Gatchalian said in an interview on radio dzBB on Sunday.
